description: Synthetic: a finished Claude Code turn at a narrow width asks whether to refresh a chart before review, with its earlier tool calls (two backgrounded agents among them) above. Every row is padded to the pane's width, as tmux captures a styled row. Below the footer the agent panel lists the two subagents with no meter, each only "waiting on N shells", and the whole panel is drawn dim. Those two rows are the subagents, both waiting, and all of them: the Agent calls in history add none. The pane waits on the user's answer.
